numerical_rules.ordinary: Unchanged C1.assess_round geometry and original Hoeffding helper for finite counts below 2^53; no new RPE estimator or approximate shot law
numerical_rules.large_integers: Reuse shots_screen._count: above binary64 integer resolution, exact rational products of stored binary64 coordinate/log constants and Python integer ceil. May differ by units from float ceil above2^53; no claim of a transcendental enclosure.
numerical_rules.extreme_attenuation: For subnormal A or old underflow/overflow status, reuse AccuracyTarget/RoundEvidence/assess_round at A=1 with same normalized errors; scale raw quantities and shot coordinate with exact Fraction(A) products. No relaxation of phase criterion.
numerical_rules.underflow_diagnostics: Nonzero exact raw product rounding to binary64 zero is null, with exact fraction-of-binary64-constants strings, normalized geometry and arithmetic-method metadata. Zero A is registered radius infeasibility, not overflow.
numerical_rules.integer_serialization: Python arbitrary integers for per-axis shots, sums and W. Canonical *_decimal fields are exact decimal strings in JSON/CSV. JSON numeric shots retained for legacy Python API; JS/Excel consumers must use canonical decimal strings.
numerical_rules.invalid: Nonfinite/negative/shape/identity mismatch => TECHNICAL_FAILURE and partial STOP. No clipping/finite cap. Missing actual synthesis/law evidence is an expected UNQUALIFIED lane.

accounting.native: C_arm,k=W_arm*mu_arm,k+S_arm,k; mu and S unknown and candidate-specific. No old M4/C1 prices, sample means, shell prices or cost proxy assumptions transferred.

classification.available: CONDITIONAL_SHOTS_AVAILABLE when both arms satisfy the declared lane and energy target
classification.infeasible: ONE_OR_BOTH_INFEASIBLE for registered phase/radius/energy sufficient-condition failure
classification.unqualified: EVIDENCE_UNQUALIFIED for missing error qualifications or unresolved numerical phase evidence
classification.technical: TECHNICAL_FAILURE for SOURCE/input/type/nonfinite/processing mismatch, partial evidence retained

correctness_STOP: First correctness failure stops dependent scalar work; save first_failure, partial outputs and failed STOP. Candidate lane infeasibility continues remaining registered cells/lanes. No retry/resume/fallback to other scientific conditions.
